text:
A: Hiya mate, can you hear me? I'm Jaspal, in Derby.
B: Yeah, I can hear you. Kacper. I'm in Swindon.
A: Swindon! Can't say I've been, to be fair. Only been past it on the M4. What do you do down there?
B: Erm, I'm a shift manager at a distribution centre. Logistics. Nights and weekends, about forty people on my team.
A: Forty people on nights? That's proper responsibility. Are you on nights now, then, or...
B: Off today. Four on, four off. I finished my last night yesterday morning, so I'm a bit knackered.
A: I bet. I'd be useless. I'm a teacher, sixth form, Business and Economics, so I'm in bed by half ten on a school night like an old man. Does the night thing mess with your sleep, or do you get used to it?
B: You sort of get used to it. The first day off is the worst. I go to the gym at like three in the afternoon and everyone's looking at me because I look half dead.
A: Ha, yeah, I clocked the shaker bottle in your photo. Serious gym man.
B: Four times a week. I track it all in an app. Squat's at one sixty at the moment.
A: One sixty kilos? Mate, I play five-a-side on a Wednesday and I'm basically there for the pint after. That's my fitness regime, that. Business and Economics, did I say? So I'm always nosy about what people do with their money, sorry. Do you do anything with yours, investing or whatever?
B: Bit of an index fund. Some crypto, a bit. I watch a lot of the finance stuff on YouTube.
A: Oh, same, I've got an app on my phone, I dabble. I do this whole lesson with the kids on crypto scams, right, and they all think I'm a genius, and then I'm at home checking my own coins going, er, why's that red?
B: Yeah. It goes up and down.
A: That's one way of putting it! What do you drive, if you're into that side?
B: BMW 1 Series. Leased. I keep it pretty clean, I get it valeted.
A: Nice. I'm fancying a new car myself, probably on finance, which as an economics teacher I know I shouldn't say out loud. What's your next move, then, work-wise? Are you after the top job at your place?
B: Operations manager, ideally. Within three years. On days, though, not nights. Better money. I'm looking at other sites as well, Amazon, Iceland, they've got big places in Swindon.
A: That's a good plan, you sound like you've actually thought about it. I keep saying I'll go for head of department and then I see the admin and go, er, maybe next year.
B: The admin's not that bad. It's mostly the people.
A: To be fair, you've got forty people, I've got seventeen-year-olds selling candles. Similar energy, probably. Do you follow the football down there? Swindon Town?
B: Loosely. I go maybe twice a season with my brother-in-law. They lost at home again last week.
A: Welcome to my world. Derby County fan. I go with my cousin and we moan about the board the whole way home, it's like a tradition. Do you play FIFA, or EA FC, whatever it is now?
B: Yeah, online. Mostly when I'm off.
A: Right, well, we should've done that as the puzzle task, I'd have actually won something.
B: Maybe. I'm alright at it.
